Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified Muhammad Ali as the person with the most BBC Sports Personality of the Year awards in Step 6. This error stemmed from confusion between the "main SPOTY" award and the "Overseas SPOTY" award. Muhammad Ali won the Overseas SPOTY three times, but the query specifically asked for the main SPOTY award, which was not clarified in the search. This mistake led to subsequent steps being based on incorrect information and caused the conversation to go off track, with repeated attempts to clarify the correct winner and their brother.
